extraction.Name: Rudolph D. Anderson
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Mortgaged to H. H. More Loan Company, Lincoln, Nebraska; traded equity to Gene Smith of Gregory, So. Dakota for 320 acres of clear land located in Todd County, So. Dakota
extraction.Buyer: Traded equity to Gene Smith of Gregory, So. Dakota; value of the half section $9600.00
extraction.NOTES: Patent delivered in 1921 at Bristow, Nebraska. Allottee applied for patent. Same year as trade, allottee traded his allotment to Gene Smith; in 1922, Fred C. Jenkins and E. R. Rusho by fraudulent means took his land and he lost everything in less than a year. Allottee is suffering from disabilities acquired in France during the World War. Wife and two children dependent: boy age five and girl age seven.
